idea: Dynamic program over multisets of square sizes. Moves are splitting a square of side s into j×j squares of side s/j (adding j²−1 squares and gaining (j−1)s), or merging an aligned j×j group back into one. Run best-first search from every k×k grid to fill a table best[n] and its realising layout, keeping the geometry as an explicit quadtree-like tree.
